title: Fine-Structure from Smith Chart
concepts: Fine-structure constant related to vacuum impedance and von Klitzing resistance: α = Z_0/(2R_K)
Inverse: α = (1-Γ)/(2(1+Γ)) — Smith-chart expression for α
Numerical verification: Γ=0.97123047248, α=0.00729735257197 vs measured 0.0072973525693
α is not another isolated triad number — it's the coupling from Möbius transformation between impedance states
Exact standard EM relationship, not a fitted coincidence
key_results: α = Z_0/(2R_K) is an exact standard EM relationship, not a fitted coincidence

α ↔ (Z_0, R_K) ↔ Γ is the correct algebraic path, not direct triad evaluation
